bagPolicy.summary: The SEC clear-bag policy applies at Stegeman Coliseum. Guests may use a clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, a one-gallon clear freezer bag, or a small clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches

parking.summary: Accessible parking is first come, first served in the Hoke Smith Annex lot for vehicles displaying a state-issued disability permit; overflow is available by the Rankin Smith Student-Athlete Academic Center.
